metadata.title: Return of the TEDI: revisiting the Triple Evolution Dynamical Instability channel in triple stars

notes: No eligible stars. This is a population-synthesis study of simulated triples, not an analysis of individually identified stars. Its “unbound stars” are unbound from their triple systems, not established as unbound from the Milky Way; the paper also finds no stars above 10^3 km s^-1 and states that the TEDI is not expected to produce hypervelocity stars (T:p17-b2; T:p18-b15). No Galactic unbound candidate is identified or followed up.
